newsitem.title: USA: Giant Industries buys Ariz. fuel distributor.
newsitem.headline: Giant Industries buys Ariz. fuel distributor.

text.p: U.S. refiner Giant Industries announced Thursday it completed the purchase of Phoenix Fuel Co. Inc, an Arizona-based fuel distributor.

Scottsdale-based Giant plans to use Phoenix's distribution system to send more petroleum products like diesel fuel and gasoline from its two New Mexico refineries to 148 owned or leased gas stations in the U.S Southwest, said Jim Acridge, Giant's chairman and chief operating officer.
"It will also serve as an entry into the lubricants market and fuel cardlock business," Acridge said in a prepared statement.
